The '''Great Ice Floes''' was a body of [[Water/Legends|ice]] located on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Toola/Legends|Toola]]. The father of the [[Whiphid/Legends|Whiphid]] [[Marakoloon]] owned holdings on the Great Ice Floes, allowing his family to make money from selling the ice to [[Merchant/Legends|merchants]].
